compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD8: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic in migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh

## Context
Create tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh with 12 behavioral test functions. All tests MUST FAIL before Task 2 (migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh does not exist). Include suite-runner guard so bash tests/run-all.sh remains green during RED phase.

## Files to Create
- tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh (new file)

## Fuzzy Match Verification
Source: migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh → normalized: migratedsoworkflowconfigsh
Test:   test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh → normalized: testmigratedsoworkflowconfigsh
Contains as substring: YES — fuzzy-match compatible, no .test-index entry needed.

## Suite-Runner Guard (Required)
Add at top of test file (after sourcing libs):
  MIGRATE_SCRIPT="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh"
  if [ "${_RUN_ALL_ACTIVE:-0}" = "1" ] && [ ! -f "$MIGRATE_SCRIPT" ]; then
      echo 'SKIP: migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh not yet implemented (RED) — tests deferred'
      printf 'PASSED: 0  FAILED: 0\n'
      exit 0
  fi

## Test Functions to Add (12 total)

1. test_migrator_rewrites_legacy_pr_ci_to_ci_pr
   Given: temp config fixture with merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; .claude/dso-config.conf contains dso.workflow=ci-pr; merge.strategy line is commented out with '# migrated to dso.workflow'

2. test_migrator_rewrites_legacy_other_to_local
   Given: temp config fixture with merge.strategy=direct only
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; dso.workflow=local in config; merge.strategy line commented out

3. test_migrator_idempotent_on_second_run
   Given: fixture already migrated (sentinel present)
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir> (second run)
   Then: exit 0; zero-byte diff on config file vs first run output

4. test_migrator_dry_run_no_modification
   Given: legacy fixture with merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir> --dry-run
   Then: exit 0; config file content is identical to before invocation

5. test_migrator_self_guard_plugin_source_repo
   Given: fixture with plugin.json present at target root
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; config file NOT modified (self-guard triggers)

6. test_migrator_false_positive_self_guard_host_with_plugins_dso
   Given: fixture with plugins/dso/ subdirectory but NO plugin.json
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; config file IS modified (treated as host project, not plugin source)

7. test_migrator_sentinel_created_after_rename
   Given: legacy fixture
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit 0; .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated sentinel file exists after run

8. test_migrator_grammar_rejection_inline_comment
   Given: fixture config containing: merge.strategy=pr # comment here
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit != 0; stderr contains diagnostic; config file unchanged

9. test_migrator_grammar_rejection_quoted_value
   Given: fixture config containing: merge.strategy="pr"
   When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
   Then: exit != 0; stderr diagnostic; config file unchanged

10. test_migrator_grammar_rejection_duplicate_key
    Given: fixture config with two merge.strategy= lines
    When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
    Then: exit != 0; stderr diagnostic; config file unchanged

11. test_migrator_grammar_rejection_crlf_line_endings
    Given: fixture config file written with CRLF line endings (printf 'merge.strategy=pr\r\n')
    When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir>
    Then: exit != 0; stderr diagnostic; config file unchanged

12. test_migrator_parity_with_read_config_shim
    Given: same legacy fixture configs (at least: pr+ci → ci-pr case; direct-only → local case)
    When: (a) bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh dso.workflow <config>
          (b) bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture_dir> --dry-run (capture resolved value from output)
    Then: both return identical dso.workflow value for each fixture

## .test-index RED Marker Requirement
Add entries for each test function so the test gate tracks RED state:
  grep -n 'test_migrator_' tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
  Add to .test-index: [test_migrator_rewrites_legacy_pr_ci_to_ci_pr]=tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
  (repeat for all 12 functions)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh (suite-runner guard keeps suite green; tests show as SKIP/deferred)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -v FAIL | tail -5
- [ ] Lint: N/A (bash file; shellcheck passes)
  Verify: shellcheck tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- [ ] Format: N/A (bash file)
- [ ] All 12 test functions present in test file
  Verify: grep -c 'test_migrator_' tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh | grep -q '12'
- [ ] All 12 tests FAIL when invoked directly (without suite-runner guard, with script absent)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED'
- [ ] .test-index has RED markers for each test function
  Verify: grep -c 'test_migrator_' .test-index | grep -q '12'
- [ ] Suite-runner guard present: test file exits 0 with SKIP message when _RUN_ALL_ACTIVE=1 and script absent
  Verify: _RUN_ALL_ACTIVE=1 bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q SKIP

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment: Add test function test_migrator_skips_rewrite_when_dso_workflow_already_present — Given fixture config with dso.workflow=ci-pr (no legacy keys, LF endings); When migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh --target=<fixture>; Then exit 0, config file unchanged, sentinel .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated created. This prevents the migrator from incorrectly overwriting an onboarding-written canonical config. Cross-reference: S4 round-trip test (test_detect_round_trip_onboarding_output_accepted_by_migrator in task 3cdb-15fe-dc6c-4a37).
